title: Add up to n
statement: Write a function `sumUpTo(n)` that returns the sum of all whole numbers from 1 up to n. Use a `for` loop. If n is 0, return 0.
prewrittenHints: Look at the first test that did not pass. Is your answer too small or too big?
A loop repeats steps. Start a running total variable before the loop.
Add each consecutive number into your accumulator variable as you count up.
conceptNote: A for loop repeats a block of code with a counter variable. Declare the accumulator outside the loop.
